panic: It is coming right for us, everybody stay calm!
Great Scott, it is as big as a department store!
Somebody do something, it is looking right at me!
Mayday, mayday, the monster sat on my jeep!
This is not in the manual, sergeant!
bravado: Ha, it is nothing but a big lizard with an attitude!
Nobody tramples my city and gets away with it!
Hold my canteen, I am going in!
I have seen bigger lizards in my garden back home!
Come on, you overgrown salamander, try me!
orders: Squad, form a line and look brave!
Aim for the scales, the shiny scales!
Everybody fire everything at the big one!
Hold the line, and somebody find my binoculars!
Charge, and do not step on the flower beds!
science: Somebody call the professor, and tell him to hurry!
Get the professor on the radio, he will know what to do!
The professor says it is radioactive and also very cranky!
Science has no answer for this, sir!
Quick, somebody fetch a scientist with a clipboard!
home: Watch it, my mother has an apartment on this street!
That is my favorite diner, you monster!
Not the bowling alley, we have league night on Thursday!
My car is parked right there, I just washed it!
Careful, that is my barbershop, I owe them money!
food: Does anybody have a sandwich, I am starving!
Somebody save the pie shop, it has the good cherry pie!
My lunch was in that jeep, and now the jeep is gone!
Maybe it is just hungry, throw it a meatloaf!
Hot coffee, I need hot coffee right now!
retreat: Fall back, fall back, it is too big!
Retreat to the drugstore and regroup!
Back up, back up, it is turning around!
Run for the hills, the actual hills!
admire: Golly, look at the size of that thing!
You have to admit, it has very nice teeth!
What a magnificent tail, I mean, open fire!
It is kind of beautiful when it smashes things!
I think it waved at me, how nice!
